codecouncil-multiplayer-ai.title: CodeCouncil
codecouncil-multiplayer-ai.shortDescription: Claude Code, but multiplayer. Shared AI coding sessions for teams.
codecouncil-multiplayer-ai.fullDescription: Shared AI coding sessions where your whole team sees the same context. Multiple developers join the same session in real-time — no more isolated sessions or pasting outputs into Slack. Sessions persist in the cloud so anyone can pick up where a teammate left off. Includes Discussion Mode where AI personas debate architecture decisions, and a built-in MCP server that connects to your entire stack. Supports 100+ models via OpenRouter.
challenges: Real-time multiplayer AI coding sessions with shared context
Persistent cloud sessions that survive restarts and handoffs
outcomes: MCP server integration for external tools

chtype-clickhouse-toolkit.title: chtype
chtype-clickhouse-toolkit.shortDescription: Type-safe ClickHouse toolkit for TypeScript — schema codegen, query builder, and enhanced client.
chtype-clickhouse-toolkit.fullDescription: TypeScript toolkit that introspects your ClickHouse schema and generates fully typed code. Includes a type-safe query builder with ClickHouse-specific functions (argMax, FINAL, PREWHERE), an enhanced client wrapping @clickhouse/client, and a CLI for schema diffing. Zero runtime overhead — prevents SQL injection by design and catches column typos at compile time.
challenges: Type-safe codegen from live ClickHouse schemas
ClickHouse-specific query builder with PREWHERE, argMax, FINAL
Schema diffing CLI to detect database drift
